name: Last-Mile Delivery
fullDescription:
SSVT Logistics provides reliable and flexible last-mile delivery solutions, connecting distribution centres, port facilities, and warehouses with project sites, industrial facilities, and end customers. Our last-mile delivery services are designed to handle the unique challenges of delivering to remote, constrained, or difficult-to-access locations.

Our fleet of delivery vehicles ranges from light commercial vehicles for small, urgent deliveries to heavy articulated trucks for large consignments. For project site deliveries, we operate all-terrain vehicles and cranes trucks capable of navigating unpaved roads and delivering to locations without fixed infrastructure.

We offer flexible delivery windows, including urgent same-day and after-hours delivery for critical project requirements. Our real-time tracking system provides delivery status updates and proof of delivery documentation. For regular delivery routes, we offer scheduled consolidated services that reduce cost and environmental impact.
